rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; same line and candidate as the refresh-round ruling. i1040gi pp. 106-108 (Schedule 1-A, Part III) and Notice 2025-69 section III.B.2 give the employer-reported or premium amount and the one-third, one-half and one-quarter conversions. Both give zero when otjob.flsa is false, the statement amount for employer_reported and premium, the three fractions for the double-time and time-and-a-half totals, and zero for method other (which otjob.h_refused refuses in both). The reply flattens the FLSA and method guards into one choice; no return differs. Project stands.
